401-2530-3944-4446.easyPrerequisites:

401-2530-3944-4446.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
401-2530-3944-4446.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

783-2645-5963-6871-7115.description:
Cast Staff of Domination by paying {3}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Jungle Basin.
Cast Marvin by paying {2}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Staff of Domination.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph, the First Metalbender triggers, earthbending Marvin, thus giving it haste.
Activate Marvin using Jungle Basin's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{G}
Activate Marvin using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Marvin.
Repeat from step 6.

2443-7675-7676.easyPrerequisites:
You can play a land this turn.
There is a land in your library that is fetchable by Evolving Wilds.
2443-7675-7676.description:
Cast Scale Up by paying {G}, targeting Tifa.
Play Evolving Wilds.
When Evolving Wilds enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn.
Activate Evolving Wilds by tapping and sacrificing it, searching your library for an applicable land and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the land enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tifa. That opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage by your commander.

When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature

Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.

Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat.

Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2626-4986-6294.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvager of Ruin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Marketback Walker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Activate Salvager of Ruin by sacrificing it, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3179-4399-4770-6719.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Dazzling Angel trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dazzling Angel trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4770-6719.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1263-4871-5256-7316.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Mona Lisa.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Mona Lisa.
Repeat.

215-1376-7297.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Priest of Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Titania by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4094-5184-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 2, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat from step 2

When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Heliod
Repeat.

When Emptiness enters, its first ability and evoke ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Emptiness, adding {W}.
Resolve Emptiness's evoke trigger, failing to sacrifice it as it's no longer on the battlefield.
Resolve Emptiness's first trigger, returning Mikey & Mona from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mikey & Mona enters, it triggers, returning Emptiness from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Mikey & Mona, adding {W}.
Repeat.

147-413-7281.description:
Cast Leonardo's Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Leonardo's Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Leonardo's Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-413-7281.notes: If desired, you can cast Leonardo's Technique for its sneak cost instead, reducing the mana cost by {2}.

An opponent cannot block and kill Zuko.
You have at least five experience counters.

Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to Ashling.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

997-1400-4619.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.

Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Repository Skaab by paying {3}{U}.
When Repository Skaab enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing it to exploit itself. Its second ability then triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Golbez's second ability triggers, returning Repository Skaab from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

222-527-4068-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4068-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
222-527-4068-6798.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

518-5940-6191.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodthirsty Conqueror has indestructible.
You control another indestructible creature.
You have a way to deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
518-5940-6191.description:
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying its mana cost, copying Arcbond, with the copy targeting another indestructible creature you control.
Resolve both Arcbonds.
Deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Arbond triggers, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to the other indestructible creature being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to Bloodthirsty Conqueror being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Repeat form step 6.

Resolve the second Aethersnipe trigger, failing to sacrifice it as it is no longer on the battlefield.
Repeat.

880-4826-4862.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.

When the land enters the battlefield, Omnath triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Arashin Sovereign into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.

Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Apprentice Wizard.
Repeat.

Cast any noncreature spell from your hand by paying its mana cost, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Draining Whelk by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Draining Whelk enters the battlefield, exiling the spell and causing you to cast the spell from exile without paying its mana cost due to Guile, and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Draining Whelk equal to the spell's mana value.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Draining Whelk.
Repeat from step 3.

3354-3373.notablePrerequisites:
Raving Dead does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents are unable to block and kill Raving Dead.

Deal combat damage to an opponent with Raving Dead.

At the beginning of your end step, Astarion triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
